text:
alex.k: POC kickoff with MerchantBank next Thursday. A few outstanding KMS/HSM items from the CS and security review we need answers on before we finalize the SOW — can they BYO HSM (Luna/CloudHSM), what rotation cadence do they require, audit/logging retention, and how does this affect hosted vs dedicated pricing?
maya.s: short answer: yes we support BYO for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted offers CMEK via customer KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) where we wrap keys — we never persist plaintext customer key material. For Private you can plug in PKCS#11-backed HSMs. For on-prem HSMs we do a connector + optional key ceremony guide.
jordan.p: security details: platform maintains immutable key usage audit trails (audit log entries + CloudTrail for AWS KMS flows). We can retain audit logs per customer retention policy (default 90d, configurable). No key material is exfiltrated by Redwood in Hosted/CMEK; key-wrapping only. For Dedicated we can support HSM attestation and module certs (FIPS/CC if customer needs).
maya.s: quick example AWS KMS policy snippet customers ask for (paste in SOW):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Sid": "AllowRedwoodToUse",
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-access"},
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }]
}
```
maya.s: note — the IAM principal will vary; SE/ops will provide the exact ARN to include.
sam.t: pricing question from procurement: what line items change if they require Dedicated HSM vs Hosted CMEK? any upfront for key ceremony?
maya.s: Hosted CMEK: small platform surcharge + per-key management fee (billed monthly). Dedicated: reserved capacity + HSM attach fee; if they want on-prem PKCS#11 connector there is an integration SOW and professional services line for the key ceremony. I can add placeholder numbers to the quote but SOW will lock exact counts.
prodsec_admin: do you support automatic rotation? we have a compliance requirement for 90-day rotation and split-key ceremony for master keys. Also need multi-region failover with replicated keys.
jordan.p: we support both scheduled rotation (via customer KMS rotation policies) and manual rotation. For split-key / quorum ceremonies, Private deployment is recommended — we provide a key ceremony runbook and can participate as ops during the ceremony on request, but Redwood does not escrow master key shares. For multi-region: keys are regional; cross-region replication is possible by replicating wrapped key material through the customer's KMS replication or storage solution — requires config in SOW.
nina.se: ops checklist for engineering: need customer's KMS ARNs (all regions), expected qps for the POC, target latency SLO, whether they require FIPS attestation and HSM vendor model. Also need contact for on-prem HSM admin if they plan BYO.
alex.k: next steps: @prodsec_admin can you send the security questionnaire answers for BYOK + rotation and the preferred HSM vendor? We'll gate the SOW on those. Maya/Jordan — can you draft the SOW appendix for KMS integration and a short pricing addendum (estimate only) by EOD Friday?
prodsec_admin: sending questionnaire now (attached). will also confirm vendor and rotation policy by EOD tomorrow.
maya.s: ack, I'll draft the appendix and include an ops-scope bullet list and the integration SOW items. I'll flag any blockers. :thumbsup:
jordan.p: I'll add the audit retention options and the key-ceremony runbook link to the doc (internal link: https://redwood-internal/docs/kms-key-ceremony).
alex.k: great — once SOW appendix is in place we can lock dates. Thanks everyone.
